title: Preserve and restore operational history
description: Project maintainers and authorized participants can retain a recoverable operational scope, restore it after local-store loss, and transfer it to another local environment without losing the original work and evidence meaning.

includes: Create an identifiable coherent backup of selected records and retained artifacts.
Validate and restore the declared scope with project association and original identities.
Transfer retained work to another authorized environment with explicit conflicts and exclusions.
excludes: Engineering Baseline recovery, which remains FEAT-006.
Interrupted transaction repair, which remains FEAT-013.
Migration of unsupported source representations, hosted backup, history synchronization or automatic conflict merging.

sources.basis: Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
